Name: (CP) Thomas the Train
Author: Tarniyar
Description:
I saw someone post once asking if there was a Thomas the Tank Engine mod, since it seemed like something that someone would have made.

Now someone has. :)

This is just a basic Content Patcher image replacement. There is no special behavior added. All your trains will be Thomas until you uninstall this mod.

Optional xnb version is available, as requested.  I strongly recommend you make a backup copy of the original Content/LooseSprites/Cursors.xnb before replacing it.

[b][size=3]New in Version 1.0.1[/size][/b]

Added support for languages other than English.

[b][size=3]Required Mods[/size][/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

[b][size=3]Other Train Mods[/size][/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4473]Train Whistle[/url] -- lets you instantly summon a train and appreciate the blueness that is Thomas!
